fields.description: Per-slot 8-byte EEPROM header word 0: LE magic 0x00224455 written by the save path and verified on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_08067d4c writes the header block at EEPROM block 9*slot via FUN_0806c874/FUN_0806c6a8/FUN_0806c6bc (base constant DAT_08067ec8); FUN_08067ef4 reads it back via FUN_0806c5f8 and rejects mismatches. Slot0 header occupies file 0..7.
fields.name: slot_header_magic

fields.description: Per-slot header word 1: stored check value. Baseline satisfies 0x4455 + sum(zero payload) + 0xBBAA == 0xFFFF (expected DAT_08067ecc).
fields.evidence: FUN_08067d4c verify loop accumulates header word + payload bytes and requires equality with DAT_08067ecc; baseline slot0 bytes 4..5 are 0xBBAA with header word 0x4455 and zero payload.
fields.name: slot_header_check

fields.description: CRC32 (custom table/invert routine, not in Schema v2 list) of payload bytes 4..63, stored at payload offset 0. Baseline is format-default zero, not a game-saved CRC.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803e6ec stores FUN_08069d40 (CRC32: init 0xFFFFFFFF, table DAT_08069e1c, final invert) over RAM save-struct +0x0e length 0x3c into u16 pair at RAM +0x0a/+0x0c (= file 8..11); called on the FUN_0803d018 save path before FUN_08067d4c.
fields.name: payload_crc32

fields.description: New-game format tag 'B','U','G',0 at payload offset 4. Baseline shows format-default zeros (title formatted EEPROM, never game-saved).
fields.evidence: FUN_0803d2e0 writes 0x42/0x55/0x47/0x00 to RAM save-struct +0x0e..+0x11 (= file 12..15) after clearing the 64-byte payload with FUN_0806cb2c.
fields.name: format_tag

fields.description: Five progress bytes shuttled between the save payload and working state; covered by payload_crc32.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803d0a0 copies RAM +0x37..+0x3B (= file 53..57) to working +0x7b..; FUN_0803d170 copies working state back to +0x37..+0x3B at store time.
fields.name: progress_bytes

fields.description: Flag-bits byte: single-bit tested by gameplay code and mirrored into the in-RAM slot directory at save time.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803886c and FUN_08038934 test bit (1 << (RAM+0x8c)) of RAM +0x3c (= file 58); FUN_0803d018 mirrors +0x3c/+0x3d into DAT_0803d09c + slot*8.
fields.name: flag_bits

fields.description: Bit-index byte paired with flag_bits; mirrored into the in-RAM slot directory at save time.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803d720 sets RAM +0x3d (= file 59) from working +0x8c; FUN_0803d018 mirrors +0x3d into DAT_0803d09c + slot*8.
fields.name: flag_bit_index

fields.description: u16 counter value shuttled between payload and working state; gameplay code assigns 99.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803c510 assigns 99 to u16 at RAM +0x3e (= file 60..61); FUN_0803d0a0/FUN_0803d170 shuttle it with working +0x80; read in FUN_08038050.
fields.name: counter_value

fields.description: Persisted byte loaded into runtime per-level array index 5; saved from working mirror.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803d018 saves working +0x95 into RAM +0x40 (= file 62); FUN_0803cf8c passes it to FUN_0803e11c(5,.); FUN_0803d170 feeds FUN_0803e11c(5,.) from +0x79.
fields.name: array_value_5

fields.description: Stage/table index into stride-12 gameplay tables; also used as a loop bound.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803e2d0 and FUN_0803d9f8 index stride-12 tables with RAM +0x41 (= file 63); FUN_0803ef98 loops while uVar < +0x41+1; mirrored with working +0x87 by FUN_0803d0a0/FUN_0803d170.
fields.name: stage_index

fields.description: Own game-slot number (0..2), stored into the payload at save time.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803d018 stores the slot param (guarded param_1 < 3) into RAM +0x42 (= file 64); FUN_08038934 branches on +0x42 vs 0/1.
fields.name: save_slot_index

fields.description: Current level index, range-checked 0..8 by the setter.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803e04c writes param_1 to RAM +0x43 (= file 65) only when param_1 < 9; compared against +0x98 in FUN_08038cdc; loop bound in FUN_0803eac0; synced from working +0x88 in FUN_0803d170.
fields.name: level_index

fields.description: 8-flag collection with atomic bit set/clear; mirrored with working state.
fields.evidence: FUN_0803e18c sets/clears bit (1 << (FUN_080380a4(0) & 0xff)) at RAM +0x44 (= file 66); FUN_0803d0a0/FUN_0803d170 shuttle it with working +0x83.
fields.name: unlock_bitflags
